mapper.sql: screening_run_id AS screeningRunId, case_id AS caseId, case_subject_id AS caseSubjectId, program_screening_id AS programScreeningId, provider_code AS providerCode, request_ref AS requestRef, trigger_source AS triggerSource, trigger_ref AS triggerRef, execution_ref AS executionRef, status, started_time AS startedTime, completed_time AS completedTime, version, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_screening_run(screening_run_id, case_id, case_subject_id, program_screening_id, provider_code, request_ref, trigger_source, trigger_ref, execution_ref, status, started_time, completed_time, version, create_time, update_time) VALUES(#{row.screeningRunId}, #{row.caseId}, #{row.caseSubjectId}, #{row.programScreeningId}, #{row.providerCode}, #{row.requestRef}, #{row.triggerSource}, #{row.triggerRef}, #{row.executionRef}, #{row.status}, #{row.startedTime}, #{row.completedTime}, #{row.version}, #{row.createTime}, #{row.updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM t_screening_run WHERE case_id IN #{id} ORDER BY case_id, started_time DESC, screening_run_id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE t_screening_run SET status = #{status}, execution_ref = #{executionRef}, completed_time = #{now}, version = version + 1, update_time = #{now} WHERE screening_run_id = #{row.screeningRunId} AND version = #{row.version} AND status = 'STARTED'
